ucs.title: [LLM] DragonForce affiliate RMM-pivot: SimpleHelp/ScreenConnect spawning LSASS dump + SMB lateral movement
ucs.description: Hunts the DragonForce intrusion chain observed in 2024-2025 MSP/downstream compromises where affiliates abuse vulnerable SimpleHelp (CVE-2024-57727) or ConnectWise ScreenConnect agents as the initial-access RMM, then immediately stage credential theft (comsvcs.dll MiniDump of lsass.exe) and pivot over SMB/RDP. Catches the actor-specific tradecraft of RMM-as-foothold → in-memory cred theft → admin share lateral move that is DragonForce's signature affiliate playbook.
ucs.splunk: | tstats `security_content_summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdline values(Processes.process_name) as child_proc values(Processes.user) as user from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.parent_process_name IN ("SimpleService.exe","Remote Access.exe","ScreenConnect.ClientService.exe","ScreenConnect.WindowsClient.exe","Remote Workforce Client.exe") (Processes.process_name IN ("rundll32.exe","powershell.exe","cmd.exe","net.exe","wmic.exe","psexec.exe","paexec.exe") OR Processes.process IN ("*comsvcs.dll*MiniDump*","*lsass*","*-accepteula*","*\\\\*\\ADMIN$*","*\\\\*\\C$*")) by Processes.dest Processes.parent_process_name Processes.parent_process_id Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.user Processes.process_id host _time span=1h | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | where NOT match(user,"(?i).*\$$") | rename dest as host_dest | sort 0 -_time
ucs.kql:
// DragonForce affiliate RMM-foothold → credential access / lateral movement chain
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let RMMParents = dynamic(["simpleservice.exe","remote access.exe","screenconnect.clientservice.exe","screenconnect.windowsclient.exe","remote workforce client.exe"]);
let CredAccessCmd = dynamic(["comsvcs.dll","minidump","lsass","sekurlsa","procdump","-ma ","nanodump"]);
let LateralBins = dynamic(["psexec.exe","paexec.exe","wmic.exe","net.exe","net1.exe","impacket"]);
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (RMMParents)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where (FileName in~ ("rundll32.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","mshta.exe")
         and ProcessCommandLine has_any (CredAccessCmd))
     or (FileName in~ (LateralBins) and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("\\\\","ADMIN$","C$","IPC$","-accepteula","\\pipe\\"))
     or (ProcessCommandLine has_any ("net use","net1 use") and ProcessCommandLine has "\\\\")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
          RMMParent     = InitiatingProcessFileName,
          RMMParentCmd  = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ChildBinary   = FileName,
          ChildCmd      = ProcessCommandLine,
          ChildSHA256   = SHA256,
          IntegrityLevel = ProcessIntegrityLevel
| order by Timestamp desc

let LookbackDays = 7d;
let RMMParents = dynamic(["simpleservice.exe","remote access.exe","screenconnect.clientservice.exe","screenconnect.windowsclient.exe","remote workforce client.exe"]);
let CredAccessCmd = dynamic(["comsvcs.dll","MiniDump","lsass","sekurlsa","procdump","-ma ","nanodump"]);

SecurityEvent

| where EventID == 4688
| extend ParentName = tolower(tostring(split(ParentProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
| extend ChildName  = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName,    "\\")[-1]))
| where ParentName in (RMMParents)
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| where (ChildName in~ ("rundll32.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","mshta.exe")
         and CommandLine has_any (CredAccessCmd))
     or (ChildName in~ (LateralBins) and CommandLine has_any ("\\\\","ADMIN$","C$","IPC$","-accepteula","\\pipe\\"))
     or (CommandLine has_any ("net use","net1 use") and CommandLine has "\\\\")
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName,
          RMMParent    = ParentProcessName,
          ChildBinary  = NewProcessName,
          ChildCmd     = CommandLine,
          TokenElevationType
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: DragonForce RMM Foothold Spawning Credential Access or SMB Lateral Movement
id: 8d1f5c2a-7c3b-4d6e-9b7f-3c4e1a2d6b1f
status: experimental
description: Detects DragonForce affiliate tradecraft where SimpleHelp/ScreenConnect RMM agents spawn LSASS dump tooling or SMB/admin-share lateral movement binaries.
references:
  - https://www.crowdstrike.com/blog/dragonforce-affiliate-tradecraft/
  - https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2024-57727
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/19
tags:
  - attack.execution
  - attack.credential_access
  - attack.lateral_movement
  - attack.t1219
  - attack.t1003.001
  - attack.t1021.002
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  rmm_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\SimpleService.exe'
      - '\Remote Access.exe'
      - '\ScreenConnect.ClientService.exe'
      - '\ScreenConnect.WindowsClient.exe'
      - '\Remote Workforce Client.exe'
  cred_access:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\rundll32.exe'
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
      - '\cmd.exe'
      - '\mshta.exe'
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'comsvcs.dll'
      - 'MiniDump'
      - 'lsass'
      - 'sekurlsa'
      - 'procdump'
      - 'nanodump'
  lateral_bins:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\psexec.exe'
      - '\paexec.exe'
      - '\wmic.exe'
      - '\net.exe'
      - '\net1.exe'
    CommandLine|contains:
      - '\\\\'
      - 'ADMIN$'
      - 'C$'
      - 'IPC$'
      - '-accepteula'
  exclude_machine:
    User|endswith: '$'
  condition: rmm_parent and (cred_access or lateral_bins) and not exclude_machine
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate sysadmin troubleshooting via the RMM agent
  - Vendor-issued maintenance scripts
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:(windows.sysmon OR windows.security) @EventID:(1 OR 4688) (@ParentImage:(*\SimpleService.exe OR *\simpleservice.exe OR *\Remote\ Access.exe OR *\ScreenConnect.ClientService.exe OR *\screenconnect.clientservice.exe OR *\ScreenConnect.WindowsClient.exe OR *\Remote\ Workforce\ Client.exe)) AND ((@Image:(*\rundll32.exe OR *\RunDll32.exe OR *\powershell.exe OR *\PowerShell.exe OR *\cmd.exe OR *\CMD.EXE OR *\mshta.exe) AND @CommandLine:(*comsvcs.dll* OR *MiniDump* OR *lsass* OR *sekurlsa* OR *procdump* OR *nanodump*)) OR (@Image:(*\psexec.exe OR *\PsExec.exe OR *\paexec.exe OR *\wmic.exe OR *\WMIC.exe OR *\net.exe OR *\NET.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*ADMIN$* OR *C$* OR *IPC$* OR *-accepteula* OR *\\\\\\\\*))) -@User:*$
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ParentBaseFileName=/(SimpleService|Remote Access|ScreenConnect\.ClientService|ScreenConnect\.WindowsClient|Remote Workforce Client)\.exe/i
| ((ImageFileName=/(rundll32|powershell|pwsh|cmd|mshta)\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/(comsvcs\.dll|MiniDump|lsass|sekurlsa|procdump|nanodump)/i) OR (ImageFileName=/(psexec|paexec|wmic|net1?)\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/(\\\\[^\\]+\\(ADMIN|C|IPC)\$|-accepteula|\\pipe\\)/i))
| NOT (UserName=/\$$/)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ParentBaseFileName, ImageFileName], function=[count(), min(@timestamp), max(@timestamp), collect([CommandLine, UserName, SHA256HashData])])

ucs.rationale: DragonForce affiliates have repeatedly weaponised vulnerable RMM appliances (SimpleHelp CVE-2024-57727 in the 2025 MSP-to-customer campaign, and ConnectWise ScreenConnect CVE-2024-1709/1708 before that) as their initial-access vector, then move directly to LSASS dumping with comsvcs.dll/procdump and SMB lateral movement with PsExec. ucs.title: [LLM] DragonForce ransomware kill-chain: BYOVD/EDR-killer → shadow-copy wipe → mass .dragonforce encryption
ucs.description: Catches the final-stage DragonForce/LockBit-Black-fork ransomware execution pattern: drop and load a vulnerable signed driver (Truesight.sys, RentDrv2.sys, gmer64.sys) to terminate EDR, then `vssadmin delete shadows /all /quiet` + `bcdedit /set recoveryenabled No` + `wbadmin delete catalog`, immediately followed by high-rate file rewrites with the `.dragonforce` (or affiliate-branded) extension. The combination within a short window is unique to ransomware deployment and the driver+extension pair is DragonForce-specific.
ucs.splunk: | tstats `security_content_summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmds values(Processes.process_name) as procs from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process IN ("*vssadmin*delete*shadows*","*wmic*shadowcopy*delete*","*bcdedit*recoveryenabled*No*","*bcdedit*bootstatuspolicy*ignoreallfailures*","*wbadmin*delete*catalog*","*wbadmin*delete*backup*") OR Processes.process_name IN ("vssadmin.exe","bcdedit.exe","wbadmin.exe") OR Processes.process IN ("*Truesight.sys*","*RentDrv2.sys*","*gmer64.sys*","*aswArPot.sys*","*sc*stop*WinDefend*","*sc*stop*Sense*","*sc*stop*SQLWriter*","*sc*stop*MsMpEng*")) by Processes.dest Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.user host _time span=10m | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | join type=inner dest [| tstats `security_content_summariesonly` count as encrypted_files values(Filesystem.file_path) as paths from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where Filesystem.file_name IN ("*.dragonforce","*.dragnf","*.DragonForce_*","*readme.dragonforce.txt","*how_to_decrypt.hta") by Filesystem.dest _time span=10m | `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)` | where encrypted_files > 50] | sort 0 -_time
ucs.kql:
// DragonForce ransomware deployment — BYOVD + shadow-copy wipe + .dragonforce extension burst
let WindowMin = 15m;
let VulnDrivers = dynamic(["truesight.sys","rentdrv2.sys","gmer64.sys","aswarpot.sys","procexp152.sys","viragt64.sys","dbutil_2_3.sys","rtcore64.sys"]);
let RecoveryKill = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(1d)
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | where FileName in~ ("vssadmin.exe","wmic.exe","bcdedit.exe","wbadmin.exe","powershell.exe","sc.exe","net.exe")
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("delete shadows","shadowcopy delete","recoveryenabled no","bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures","delete catalog","delete backup","Get-WmiObject Win32_Shadowcopy","stop WinDefend","stop Sense","stop SQLWriter","stop MsMpEng")
    | project RecoveryTime = Timestamp, DeviceName, RecoveryCmd = ProcessCommandLine, RecoveryUser = AccountName;
let DriverLoad = DeviceImageLoadEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(1d)
    | where FileName has_any (VulnDrivers)
    | project DriverTime = Timestamp, DeviceName, Driver = FileName, DriverPath = FolderPath;
let EncBurst = DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(1d)
    | where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileRenamed","FileModified")
    | where FileName endswith ".dragonforce" or FileName endswith ".dragnf"
          or FileName matches regex @"(?i)readme.*dragonforce.*\.(txt|hta)"
          or FileName matches regex @"(?i)how_to_decrypt.*\.(txt|hta)"
    | summarize EncTime = min(Timestamp), EncryptedFiles = count(),
                EncProc = any(InitiatingProcessFileName),
                EncCmd = any(InitiatingProcessCommandLine)
                by DeviceName, bin(Timestamp, WindowMin)
    | where EncryptedFiles > 25;
EncBurst
| join kind=inner RecoveryKill on DeviceName
| where RecoveryTime between (EncTime - WindowMin .. EncTime + WindowMin)
| join kind=leftouter DriverLoad on DeviceName
| project EncTime, DeviceName, EncryptedFiles, EncProc, EncCmd,
          RecoveryCmd, RecoveryUser, Driver, DriverPath
| order by EncTime desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// DragonForce ransomware deployment — recovery wipe correlated to .dragonforce file burst
let WindowMin = 15m;
let RecoveryKill = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
    | where CommandLine has_any ("delete shadows","shadowcopy delete","recoveryenabled no","bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures","delete catalog","delete backup","Win32_Shadowcopy","stop WinDefend","stop Sense","stop SQLWriter","stop MsMpEng")
    | project RecoveryTime = TimeGenerated, Computer, RecoveryCmd = CommandLine, RecoveryUser = SubjectUserName;
let EncBurst = ImFileEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
    | where EventType in ("FileCreated","FileModified","FileRenamed")
    | where TargetFileName endswith ".dragonforce" or TargetFileName endswith ".dragnf"
          or TargetFileName matches regex @"(?i)readme.*dragonforce.*\.(txt|hta)"
    | summarize EncTime = min(TimeGenerated), EncryptedFiles = count(),
                EncProc = any(ActingProcessName),
                EncCmd = any(ActingProcessCommandLine)
                by Computer = DvcHostname, bin(TimeGenerated, WindowMin)
    | where EncryptedFiles > 25;
EncBurst
| join kind=inner RecoveryKill on Computer
| where RecoveryTime between (EncTime - WindowMin .. EncTime + WindowMin)
| project EncTime, Computer, EncryptedFiles, EncProc, EncCmd, RecoveryCmd, RecoveryUser
| order by EncTime desc
